column2: Loads AccountsFile and takes token a/c to strategy
Does login in accounts if not already logged in by checking date on the token file
Loads keystore and the instruments based upon the index provided by the keystore
Based upon the keystores we'll have Strategy object for every keystore provided
We'll mark keystorePresent for that particular index for which keystore is present
And then based on this keystorePresent var, we'll load instruments and create pipeline
We'll set Timer for every one minute, to check strategy entries/exits
Based on the very first account(which belongs to Zerodha), we'll create socket
Then finally we'll create pipeline after subscribing the tokens for the instruments required for the day
